entities.summary: Mikael Olli Axel Jantunen is a Finnish professional basketball player for Fenerbahçe of the Turkish Basketbol Süper Ligi (TBSL) and the EuroLeague, and for the Finland national team. He played college basketball for the Utah Utes.
